records.issue_text: packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx:2 — This UI-package module imports its own public barrel, creating a MultiEmail-to-index-to-MultiEmailLazy cycle that makes loading and refactoring fragile.
records.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: MultiEmail.tsx imports Button, EmailField, Icon, Tooltip from "@calcom/ui", while packages/ui/index.tsx adds `export { default as MultiEmail } from "./form/MultiEmailLazy"` and MultiEmailLazy dynamically imports MultiEmail — a genuine barrel cycle created by this change. It's not demonstrably broken behavior (dynamic import likely avoids runtime deadlock), so it's a concrete architecture/refactoring fragility concern rather than a bug, though borderline.
